interceptor.why: InvoiceList receives AngularJS $http via react2angular's injected-props argument ['$http'], so authInterceptor (headers and 401 retry) still applies, and the message says so.

order.why: The component sorts a copy of invoices by issuedAt descending via time(b.issuedAt) - time(a.issuedAt).

mount.why: react2angular(InvoiceList, ['customerId'], ['$http']) registers the 'invoiceList' component, and the useEffect depends on customerId so binding changes refetch.
